assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production illustration asset for a premium Chinese cultural travel passport mobile app. Create a square 2-by-2 collectible museum stamp illustration atlas with four distinct, beautifully crafted circular medallions, each exactly centered within its own equal quadrant. All four shown straight-on, same scale, fully visible and uncropped; medallions fill 76% of each quadrant and have generous equal empty gutters. Transparent canvas outside medallions. These are sophisticated collectible art objects with exquisitely engraved details and subtle dimensional ceramic/enamel surfaces, not UI mockups, not cartoon gaming achievements, not generic app icons. TOP LEFT: deep cobalt-blue and pale porcelain medallion featuring a magnificent Chinese ancient bronze ding vessel, engraved waves, subtle satin silver frame and carved relief, museum-quality fine details. TOP RIGHT: warm vermilion and blush porcelain medallion featuring a sculptural contemporary art museum with graceful curving concrete architecture, tiny abstract sculpture and delicate architectural linework. BOTTOM LEFT: celadon and pale ivory medallion featuring majestic misty Chinese mountain peaks with fine topographic engraving and a little river. BOTTOM RIGHT: aubergine and lilac medallion featuring an abstract geometric modern-art sculpture with stacked spheres and arches. Visual language: contemporary museum gift-shop limited edition, collectible engraved porcelain relief, crisp intricate linework, sculptural central subject with believable volume, restrained enamel finish, fine ornamental radial edges, art-directed editorial elegance, soft top-left studio lighting, no exaggerated chrome or gold luxury. Each should be exceptionally well composed and recognizable at thumbnail size. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no titles, no drop shadow outside each circle, no backing cards.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: landscape editorial photograph for the discovery page of a fictional Chinese museum in a premium cultural travel passport prototype. Architecture by an imagined contemporary architect, not identifiable as any real museum. Wide composition with a clear monumental curve in upper right and gentle open sky at top. Soft natural daylight, realistic textures, restrained colors, editorial architectural photography, warm light but neutral balanced whites, exceptionally refined and calm, 35mm lens, no exaggerated HDR, no oversaturated orange, no fog, no text, no logos, no UI, no watermark.
